newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL SHRS SURGE ON POSSIBLE SELL-OFF DELAY.
newsitem.headline: MOL SHRS SURGE ON POSSIBLE SELL-OFF DELAY.

text.p: Shares of Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt surged some five percent to a new record high on Monday as the market took in the possible delay of the next phase of MOL's privatisation, traders said.
MOL shares surged to a new record high of 4,990 forints, up 285, before giving up some. At 1104 GMT MOL shares traded at 4,950 forints.
"If there is no IPO this year, funds - both domestic and foreign - will have to buy MOL shares on the stock exchange," said Sandor Szendi of Postabank Securities.
Press reports last week suggested that the next MOL offering might not happen this year, as expected earlier.
